revised_rules.title: layer=first: a first horizon starting within 5 cm counts as surface (surface_within_5cm); beyond 5 cm no first horizon (WoSIS, WISE)
layer=first: first mineral horizon (WoSIS organic_surface false; SOTER HBDE >= 0 or null), first_mineral
SOTWIS identical source rows (CAF RW41): one layer, the copies hidden
SOTWIS SOTERsummaryFile_T1S1D1 layers hidden (declared copy of the D1 layer)
SOTWIS PRID linked without case between summary and estimates (and the TTR flags of /sotwis/ttr-flags) where no estimate profile has the same spelling; pairs listed
SOTWIS CECc and ELCO of the SN-GM, TN, UT summary rows read from the estimates (value_from_estimates)

SOTER profile repeated in a national or more specific dataset: when the original (ZA, AR/CU, UT) is in the selection, the values of the copy (SAF, LAC, KE) that the original holds with the same value are hidden; values only in the copy stay (kept_from_copy), differing values stay on both (values_differ)
negative value of a non-negative quantity = missing (SOTWIS codes, WISE CACO3 -1); the code in revised_markings.hidden_values
WISE 'Not measured' per laboratory and property: zeros of group 1 = nodata (groups 2 and 3 only flagged)
WISE ECE 0.1 in profiles all at 0.1: flag uniform_profile_value (no exclusion)
values impossible for the declared unit excluded; extremes flagged extreme; WoSIS PHPRTN above 100 flagged above_unit_maximum
SOTER: empty rows skipped by layer=first; Nepal top_depth_cm from the first number of HBDE_ORIGINAL (top_depth_from_hbde_original, open_ended)
SOTER orphan horizons whose PRID differs only by case joined to the existing profile
WoSIS sand + silt + clay rescaled to 100 (texture_normalized with the original sum)
WoSIS BDFIFM elements 'guessed value, expert field estimate' excluded (the cell disappears when none remains)
SOVEUR v1 layers equal to the v2 T1S1D1 layer of the same unit hidden (both versions are in sotwis_polygons)
SOTWIS TCEQ above 120 where declared g C kg-1: flag impossible_for_declared_unit (no exclusion)

unchanged.note: WoSIS horizons tied at 0: all candidates (tie), as raw
SOTER synthetic/virtual profiles: included, as raw
